_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base rate is a coil (3% chance of ±2 score move); no ETF/stablecoin impulse or liquidation breaker, so phase stays put until the range resolves.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both cautious, but analyst explicitly HOLDs Anxiety while narrative stresses crowded-long downside risk without a forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound and fear_greed holds ~32-46 with no sustained ETF or stablecoin impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: long liquidation through the coil or sudden ETF/stablecoin surge that moves composite score ±2 out of the Anxiety band
